Job Overview and Employer Details

Fanzart - Designer Fans has listed an opening for a Business Development Specialist located in Ranchi, Jharkhand, India. The position involves working on-site to drive business growth, manage sales pipelines, and engage with prospective clients within the region.

Role Requirements and Qualifications

According to the job listing, candidates are expected to bring specific skills and educational backgrounds to the role:

  • Skills & Experience: Strong analytical skills, market research capabilities, effective communication, and customer service experience. Candidates should have a proven background in lead generation, sales pipeline management, and meeting business development targets.
  • Preferred Background: Relevant experience in sales, business development, retail, or consumer durables—ideally within home decor or luxury products—is considered beneficial.
  • Education & Tools: A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred, alongside proficiency in basic CRM tools and MS Office.
  • Work Arrangement: The position requires working on-site in Ranchi, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and undertaking local travel as needed.

Practical Implications and Verification

For professionals interested in the designer fans and luxury home decor sector in Jharkhand, this listing presents a local on-site opportunity. Applicants should note that specific details such as salary figures, application deadlines, exact selection processes, and recruitment numbers are not specified in the public posting.

Readers can review the full job description, check platform updates, and access direct application steps by visiting the official source on [LinkedIn India](https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/view/business-development-specialist-at-fanzart-designer-fans-4484908686).
